objective: Reduce the complete additional cost of checking one exact linear training shard to at most half of optimized minimal replay, under a declared local compute-group assumption.
method: Replay forward; reconstruct the weight gradient from the weight update and a compact rounding remainder; check both backward products with independent exact integer projections.
pricing_note: Hypothetical accounting scenarios fixed before measurement, not AWS price quotes. Both controls use the same compute and traffic rates. Free transfer still incurs the modeled bandwidth and latency cost.
accounting: Include producer output encoding and commitment, auditor input validation and hashing, decoding, all arithmetic, output authentication, complete input/output traffic, and the candidate's additional challenge exchange. Exclude only ordinary useful training shared by both methods; also report its cost and combined totals. Network times are serialized payload/RTT models, not measured WAN performance. Initial input validation is charged even for cached inputs.
control: Fastest of optimized exact binary64 minimal replay and the existing exact binary64 reference training with the same compact boundary wire format, admission, and authentication. Validate both against the independent int64 oracle. No intermediate witness is required by replay.
assumptions: producer commitment fixed before fresh private verifier randomness
attacks: coherent fabricated gradient and weight update
pass_rule: All correctness and adversarial checks must pass. On the primary shape and scenario, every paired sample must have both accounted audit cost and modeled serialized audit latency at most 0.5 of the faster replay control. All other shapes/scenarios and complete work-plus-audit ratios must be published. Passing does not establish Transformer verification, GPU savings, auditor independence or a public audit market.
stop_rule: One frozen candidate. Publish a miss without changing thresholds, shapes, numerical rules or pricing. No GPU trial or native integration follows. A later attempt needs a separate prospectively frozen rationale.
